character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Vikhroli lives a double life shaped by Godrej. The west side hums with corporate offices, green campuses and the calm of the mangroves; the east buzzes with dense colonies like Kannamwar Nagar and Tagore Nagar, busy markets and everyday family life. Few Mumbai suburbs pair big-company polish with such grounded, community-driven living. The community is a friendly mix of Maharashtrian, South Indian, North Indian and Gujarati families - many with multi-generational ties to Godrej - alongside young professionals drawn by value housing and Powai proximity. It's hardworking, rooted and quietly green.

faq.question: What is Vikhroli known for?
faq.answer: Vikhroli is best known as the home of the Godrej Group - including the vast Pirojshanagar township, the Godrej & Boyce manufacturing complex, the Godrej One corporate HQ and the famous Godrej mangroves. It is a unique blend of corporate, industrial, residential and green spaces in central-east Mumbai.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Vikhroli?
faq.answer: Vikhroli falls under pin code 400079 (Vikhroli West / Park Site) and 400083 (Vikhroli East / Kannamwar Nagar), within the S ward of Mumbai.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Vikhroli?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Vikhroli are Vikhroli West, Vikhroli East, Pirojshanagar (Godrej township), Park Site, Kannamwar Nagar, Tagore Nagar, Surya Nagar and the Godrej mangrove belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Vikhroli?
faq.answer: Property prices in Vikhroli range from ₹80 lakh to ₹1.2 Cr for a 1BHK to ₹1.6–2.6 Cr for a 2BHK in towers along the LBS Marg and Godrej developments, and ₹3 Cr+ for premium new-construction homes. Rental rates range from ₹22,000 to ₹55,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Vikhroli?
faq.answer: Vikhroli is served by Vikhroli station on the Central Line (40 min to CSMT), the Eastern Express Highway, the LBS Marg, the upcoming Metro, and BEST bus routes 396, 460, 461. Powai, Ghatkopar, Mulund and the airport are all within easy reach.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Vikhroli?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Vikhroli include Hiranandani Hospital (Powai, nearby), Godrej Memorial Hospital, Fortis (Mulund, nearby), and several multi-speciality clinics along LBS Marg and Vikhroli West.

faq.question: Which schools are in Vikhroli?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Vikhroli include Udayachal High School (Godrej), St. Joseph's High School, Tagore Nagar schools, and several CBSE and SSC options across Vikhroli West and East.
